Revised one normalized Chinese waitlist sentence; compared final output and confirmed only that sentence changed, with all English and remaining locale article blocks identical.

SureSignal beta/company verification mechanism not an independent results audit.
trans-GEO and trans-AI Voice are distinct specific workflows, no revenue/accuracy guarantees.

semantic_review.localization_risks: Facts and qualifiers preserved. Generated Simplified wording retains some shared cross-regional terms (e.g. 讯号/介面); read for meaning, without claiming independent human proofreading.
